items.review_rationale: Read an epimorphism as right-cancellable under composition into an arbitrary target W in a category; did not substitute surjectivity of underlying functions in a general category.

references.context: Category-domain and codomain matching required to form composites a∘f and b∘f.
Whenever parallel a,b have equal composites on the right with f, they must already be equal.

references.phrase: for all objects W and all parallel arrows Y→W
references.disposition: This categorical universal quantification is essential; an arbitrary epimorphism need not be surjective on underlying elements.

items.review_rationale: Read a monomorphism as left-cancellable under composition from an arbitrary source W in a category; preserved orientation f∘a=f∘b and avoided assuming set-level injectivity.

references.phrase: category C with its objects and morphisms

references.context: Arrows from a common object W with codomain X, composable on the left with f:X→Y.
Equality f∘a=f∘b implies a=b for every suitable pair of parallel arrows.

references.phrase: for all objects W and all parallel arrows W→X
references.disposition: Categorical monicity is quantified over every source object; it is not defined by elementwise injectivity in arbitrary categories.
